firstPlayerRule: Each player pops the Pop-O-Matic die once. The player who pops the highest number goes first, and play continues to their left.
houseFallback: If players tie for the highest pop, those players pop again.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Winning Moves-hosted rules PDF listed on winning-moves.com/rules/ and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 1: "WHO STARTS THE GAME: Each player rolls the die by pressing down the top of the Pop-O-Matic once, then letting go. The player who pops the highest number goes first. Play continues to the left of the starting player."
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for equal high pops.
